title: FRT & RR CONSOLE, WIPER RELAY & SIDE TRIM PANELS
summary: Front console (shifter / center console trim plate area) and rear console, the wiper relay under the dash, and the LH/RH side trim panels (kick panels at the lower dash ends), all models. The front console is screwed into U-nuts on a floor bracket and the dash; the rear console sits on a reinforcement and is held by nuts from below (View A); the kick panels are screwed to the hinge pillar (View B), with an extra RH cover on convertibles (19467).

fastening.to: RH side of the lower dash / hinge pillar
fastening.note: Screw [1] goes through the flange of cover [2] (convertible only); the cover's two holes line up with two studs/tabs on the RH side trim panel [3].
View B: screw asm. [7] goes through the LH side trim panel [12] into a hole in the pillar (triangle 1 in View B).

fastening.to: U-nuts [6] on the console floor bracket and dash
fastening.note: Main view: screws asm. [7] go through the sides of the front console into U-nuts [6]; dashed lines run to U-nuts on the bracket on the floor tunnel and on the dash lower edge.
Screw [10] goes in from the LH side at the top of the front console.

fastening.to: bracket under the instrument panel, LH of the console
fastening.note: Screw [9] goes down through the mounting ear of wiper relay [8] into the bracket (U-nut [6] at the bracket end).
View A: studs on the underside of the rear console pass down through reinforcement [4]; nuts [11] go on from below.

fastening.to: floor tunnel at the rear of the console
fastening.note: Bolt asm. [5] at the rear console end on the tunnel; dashed line from the reinforcement [4] end. Exact attachment not fully clear.
